steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical plus RFQ stage pair.
Assert that both required stage tabs exist.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add the required RFQ line item.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Invite one QA test vendor without inventing a vendor name.
Publish the configured event.
Assert that publishing reached the project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the Technical stage first to inspect whether RFQ-only clauses are absent there.
Assert that the RFQ clause is not shown on the Technical stage.
Assert that the optional RFQ clause is also not shown on the Technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing round where the clauses should be presented.
Accept the required payment clause.
Accept the optional delivery clause.
Submit a quote of 100 for every RFQ line.
Assert that the vendor submission was accepted.
